name: dev-guard
description: A simple security auditor for VS Code-compatible IDE extensions that checks for known malicious extensions.
author: v0ldemort5545-unsafe_call

commands.title: Extension Security Auditor: Check Installed Extensions

devGuard.telemetry.enabled.description: Send pseudonymous usage statistics to pkgscan.dev. When a malicious extension is found, its ID and installed version are included. No file paths are collected. Respects VS Code's global telemetry setting.
